 Sat, 21 November 2026 
 By TRN Online,Kathmandu, Nov 21: Lumibini lions lost its first wicket as Aasif Sheikh got out scoring 1 run in 4 balls. Sheikh got out in LBW on Scott Kuggeleijn ball. 
 Sudurpaschim Royals won toss and elected to field first against Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League Season-3 final match being played at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
